asistente_credenciales.kick.paso1.texto: In Kick, go to Settings → Developer. You need two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled on your account to get in here.
asistente_credenciales.kick.paso2.texto: Click “Create app” (or the equivalent button) to get started.

asistente_credenciales.kick.paso4.sin_ur: Without a public URL, Kick chat isn't available. You can continue without this: streaming works the same, only the chat will be missing.
asistente_credenciales.kick.paso4.texto_: If you want Kick chat in the panel, turn on “Enable Webhooks” and paste this address:
asistente_credenciales.no_se_pudo_copiar: Your browser won't let you copy here. Select the text and copy it by hand.
asistente_credenciales.por_que_kick: Kick doesn't support public apps shared across different installations: each integration needs its own registered app. There's no way around this.
asistente_credenciales.por_que_pregunta: Why are they asking for this?
asistente_credenciales.por_que_youtube: YouTube allocates its API quota per project, not per user: if Splitstream used an app shared by everyone, anyone could exhaust it and leave you unable to create broadcasts. With your own project, the quota is yours alone.
